title: Sewer Funding & Service Car Permit Policy
summary:
*   The city approved a $982 payment to reimburse expenses, including printing and legal fees, for the Austin City Sewer Disposal Plant Bonds.
*   A public service car permit (for a for-hire vehicle like a taxi) issued to O.H. Levingston for his Dodge was officially revoked.
*   The permit was cancelled because Levingston had not activated or used it since its approval the previous month.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL: Austin, Texas, Sept. 16, 1918.

The Council met with all members present.
Mayor Wooldridge laid before the Council the following resolution: App'l l. by
H.A. Wroe
expenses
of Bond Issue
RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS: That the sum of Nine Hundred
Eighty-two Dollars ($982.00) be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the General
Contingent Fund of the City of Austin, Texas, and made payable to H. A. Wroe, the buyer of
the Austin City Sewer Disposal Plant Bonds.
This appropriation is to reimburse the said H. A. Wroe for expenses incurred in connection
with the printing of these bonds, attor- ney's fee, etc.
The resolution was adopted by a vote of 5 yeas, no nays.
APPROVED, Sept. 16, 1918: A. P. Wooldridge, Mayor.
The Council then adjourned.

V. E. Marrs
City Clerk

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL: Austin, Texas, Sept. 17, 1918.

The Council met with all members present. O.H. Levingston
service car
Permit
revoked
On motion of the Mayor, the public service car permit granted August 14 to O. H.
Levingston, on his Dodge car No. 186967, and never taken out by him, was revoked by vote
of 5 yeas, no nays.
The Council then adjourned.

V. E. Marrs
City Clerk
